name: 10002 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10002 (New York) has 366 nonprofit organizations. 155 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 137 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10002 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
